Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Use a Reaction to gain 2 Boons to defend against a visible attack, then move 1 square without provoking.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
One hour preparing the cover together.
Target / range / shape
Self and up to three willing companions.
Equipment / acquisition
Suitable clothing and acquired information for the roles.
Type
Skill / Utility

Prepare a coherent mundane cover for yourself and up to three willing companions using suitable clothing and information you have obtained. Each participant gains 2 Boons to Guile or Reason rolls sustaining that cover while using it. The cover persists until abandoned or materially contradicted.
